title: Cannot send Spool to X1-Series
body:
There are two possible problems.

1. The script up to and including version 1.4.5 contains a bug, but it will likely be fixed with my pull request. [#28 ]

2. Sending MQTT to the X1 series only works up to and including firmware version 01.08.02.00!

BambuLab introduced authorization with firmware version 01.08.05.00. This is initially only possible via Bambu Connect or if everything is set to LAN Only, thus eliminating the cloud.

So downgrade to version 01.08.02.00 via the mobile app.

(I don't know if this also applies to the P1 and A1 series.)
author: tugsi

comments.body: That's not a problem with x-series, it is related to missing setting_id from bambu studio, so the filament can't set correct to the ams.

comments.body: Was genau soll das fixen? an dieser Stelle werden einfach unnötige Zeichen entfernt, insofern vorhanden?

Nicht ganz: Falls der bereinigte String undefined, leer oder null ist, wird ein leerer String ('') als Fallback-Wert verwendet.
Denn ich habe mit meinem X1C dort anscheinend nicht die passenden Werte, denn ich habe (egal mit welchem Browser) immer den UncaughtError bei dem replace-Befehl. 
Somit kann ich keine Spule die ich per RFID oder so auswähle, über das Spool_In-Icon in das AMS oder externe Spule übergeben. 
Erst durch den Fix, definiere ich das Feld als leer in so einem Fall und der Befehl geht durch.

Ok, das ist aber nicht X-Series spezifisch. Dann hat die Spule keine Bambu Settings in Spoolman hinterlegt?
Ohne die bambu_idx kann das Filament gar nicht korrekt gesetzt werden.

Richtig, wenn ich in Spoolman hingehe und ein Filament aussuche, dann hab ich eine große Liste an allen möglichen Herstellern, auch die BambuLab eigenen, aber dort ist die Bambu Filament IDX nicht hinterlegt. 
Also das Feld leer und wenn ich das so auswähle, dann fehlen mir die Daten und Dein Code strauchelte da. 
Im Grunde ja nur ein Abfangen, wenn es nicht gibt, halb so wild, dann lass es leer. Im Drucker ist es trotzdem nutzbar.

title: Fix BufferSize for larger JSONs from X-Series
body: 5kB are too small for the large JSON from the X-Series, JSON is 15403Bytes large, a little bit buffer so I made 15488Bytes.

title: Usermod for M3 heat inserts and AliExpress parts
body: I loved the project idea but wanted a more cost-effective solution, so I sourced parts from AliExpress. Since they didn’t fit the stock print files, I modified them accordingly. While making adjustments, I also replaced M4 screws with M3 VORON heat inserts for consistency and ease of use, added holes for socket head screws on the printed scale part, so they sit flush.

title: Feature Request: Automatic assign Filament to Bambulab AMS - No web UI needed
body:
Hello,

first of all, thank you for this project.
As I already mentioned on Youtube, it would be great when we don't need the WebUi to change the filament in the Bambulab AMS.

I could imagine the following workflow. Maybe it is possible to integrate it into Filaman.

1. Unload old filament from any slot.
2. Scan NFC Tag and weight new filament with Filaman.
3. Load new filament into the empty slot.
4. Filaman automatically sets the filament information/setting for the AMS slot.

I hope that the idea is clear to understand.

This would be a great feature, so we don't have to do any manual interaction (webui/app) when we load a new filament.
Currently I don't use Filaman, but this could be an nice feature.

Thanks 
Nico
author: N1c093

comments.body:
Hey Nico,

thanks for the Idea, i added this to my Todo List :)

I think we have to add some custom fields to spoolman to have the ability to map a spool/Filament from spoolman to existing Filament profiles in the AMS.
Otherwise you would have to make Sure a Profile for every Filament (vendor/Material) combimation hast to existing on your machine.
So an easier and more flexible approach would be to have mapping fields to overcome the (maybe) non existent Profile combination on the machine.

What do you think?
FilaMan creates some extra filed for that.

This Feature is implemented now.
You can enable auto Set Spool to AMS in Spoolman/Bambu Settings.
